{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:maize|corn]] off the cob
* 6 cups water
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] unsalted [[Cookbook:butter|butter]]
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:flour|flour]]
* 1 large [[Cookbook:egg|egg]]
* [[Cookbook:salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:pepper|Pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
# Combine the corn and water in a large pot. Bring to a [[Cookbook:boil|boil]].
# Make a [[Cookbook:roux|roux]] with the butter and flour.  
# Add the roux to the [[Cookbook:soup|soup]] when the corn is tender.  
# Boil for an additional 10–15 minutes.
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the egg and add it to the soup. Immediately take the soup off the heat.  
# Add salt and pepper to taste.
